versions.content: The Ea module shall call the function defined in the configuration parameter EaNvMJobErrorNotification upon failure of an asynchronous erase operation after performing all necessary internal management and error handling operations. Failure of an asynchronous erase operation implies the erase job for immediate data is finished and has failed (see SWS_Ea_00064).
